threshold_candidates: nextafter(min,-inf) + every sorted unique float64 score + nextafter(max,+inf)
robust_theta: ordinary numeric median of all 12 fold thresholds
family_selection: threshold MAD not compared across different scales

classification_rule_frozen_before_result.READY: at least one family passes eligibility and all development gates
classification_rule_frozen_before_result.UNSTABLE: if no READY family and every family has at least two no-eligible folds, or every family fails at least three eligible held-out speaker recall gates
classification_rule_frozen_before_result.SIGNAL_WEAK: otherwise, when continuous signal exists but no family passes all gates
